kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: People are watching the Reflecting Pool like reality TV. What does that say about us?
wire.summary: It's not just watching paint dry. The twists and turns of the Reflecting Pool repairs, originally a two-week project, have kept bloggers and viewers busy all summer.

wire.title: Independent autopsy "inconclusive" on cause of death for 18-year-old Nolan Wells in Mississippi
wire.summary: An independent autopsy of the body of Nolan Wells shows that the cause of death is undetermined pending an investigation, according to attorney Ben Crump.

wire.title: Greetings from Jerusalem, whose holy sites host some of the oldest colonies of nesting swifts
wire.summary: The scythe-winged birds have nested in the cracks of the Western Wall and other holy sites in Jerusalem for thousands of years.

wire.title: Trump to attend dignified transfer of fallen soldiers. And, Hegseth testifies on Iran
wire.summary: Trump will attend the dignified transfer of U.S. service members killed in the Middle East. And, Pete Hegseth is requesting billions from Congress to help with the rising cost of the war in Iran.

wire.title: Her son was killed by ICE at a traffic stop. She says she's still waiting for justice
wire.summary: Ruben Ray Martinez, 23, was fatally shot by an ICE agent two months into President Trump's second term. His mother says her family has yet to receive justice.

wire.title: U.S. and Iranian attacks continue as tensions mount on a key waterway in the Red Sea
wire.summary: The fighting comes as the Trump administration is seeking billions of dollars more from Congress for the war with Iran, which Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth says has already cost $37.5 billion.

wire.title: What forecasters expect this hurricane season, as Tropical Storm Bertha edges along
wire.summary: The El Niño weather pattern could limit how many Atlantic storms form this year. But unusually warm waters temperatures mean the risk of destructive storms is still high.

wire.title: Peptides get their regulatory close-up
wire.summary: A panel of advisers to the Food and Drug Administration will meet this week to make recommendations on whether specialized pharmacies should be allowed to make some popular wellness peptides.

wire.title: States want to bring Medicaid behind bars. Federal changes make that harder
wire.summary: Funding cuts and program changes required by President Trump's big budget law are forcing states to rethink bipartisan efforts to bring Medicaid into jails and prisons.

wire.title: Trump has campaigned more so far in 2026 midterms than he did at this point in 2018
wire.summary: Heading to Georgia on Wednesday, President Trump is campaigning more often this year than he did in the same period for 2018 and has already rallied for a dozen candidates in toss-up races.

wire.title: US to announce deal allowing Saudi Arabia a nuclear programme
wire.summary: The agreement would fulfil a long-held Saudi ambition but could attract concern in Israel and from some US lawmakers.

wire.title: Trump threatens to target Iran's bridges and power plants if Hormuz attacks persist
wire.summary: Donald Trump says the US will respond any time Iranian forces shoot at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

wire.title: Tankers make sharp U-turns after Houthi shipping threat
wire.summary: All of the ships were travelling to or from Saudi ports before changing course, ship-tracking data shows.

wire.title: British woman jailed for blackmail after accusing banker of rape in Hong Kong
wire.summary: Isabel Rose was convicted of trying to extort £100,000 from the UK banker and perverting the course of justice.

wire.title: Wreckage of Pan Am plane that shaped aviation safety found 74 years on
wire.summary: The deaths of 52 people on the Clipper Endeavor led to the introduction of mandatory pre-flight safety briefings.

wire.title: Mamdani walks back pledge to arrest Netanyahu citing lack of authority
wire.summary: The New York City mayor instead called on US authorities to act on International Criminal Court's arrest warrant against the Israeli prime minister.
